title: These are pretty
text: These are pretty. I am happy to have found these at such a good price. We want to put them in one of our pine trees this Christmas. They will make a great addition to our ever growing holiday outdoor décor, they are bright and vibrant and will show up nicely in our otherwise dark backyard.

product_metadata.title: PHILIPS Multicolor 5.5" Hanging Sphere Light with 50 LED Bulbs - UL Listed for Indoor/Outdoor Use - 50 Mini LED Bulbs in Hanging Ball - Winter Decoration for Parties
features: ENERGY-SAVING AND LONG-LASTING - LED lightbulbs are highly energy-efficient, lasting up to 20 times longer and with up to 80% energy savings compared to most incandescent sets! Each set is covered by a 5-year Guarantee

WEATHER-PROOF - These Winter light sets are weatherproof, making them the perfect lighting for your indoor or outdoor space. Use these decorative lights inside or outside without having to stress about damage from rain or snow.

BEAUTIFUL GLISTEN EFFECT - Add a warm glow to your space with these glistening Icicle Lights. Philips decorative lights are great for illuminating your porch, deck, balcony, windows, or any other space.

LENGTH AND BULB COUNT - These icicle lights have a 14.5-foot lighted length and a 24-inch lead-in. The 150 bulbs are each spaced 3 inches apart, with an alternating icicle length pattern of 4 and 6 inches (4-6-4-6). Connect up to 18 strands for a total of 2700 lights

SAFE AND MULTIPURPOSE - These hanging sphere lights have cool running LED bulbs along with a replaceable fuse in the plug that prevents overload. Philips decorative lights have passed rigorous UL safety testing. Use these winter lights to decorate and illuminate any place indoors or outdoors - from windows to trees to fences and more!
description: Brighten up any holiday with this Philips LED 50lt 5.5" Hanging Multi Colored Super Sphere. This energy efficient sphere comes with a 16 inch nylon hanging loop for easy decorating on your house or in your trees. A total of 45 spheres can be connected end to end for a total of 2,250 lights. Each UL listed set is protected by a 5-Year guarantee from the certified third-party seller.
